original.comparator: marked form (`ACTION, no-undo.` / `ACTION, can-undo(PATH[; HOLDER][; WINDOW][; COST]).`) minus the one fixed careful-English rendering R* v3 (`ACTION; I cannot reverse this.` / `ACTION; I can reverse this via PATH[ within N units][; cost COST].` / `ACTION; HOLDER can reverse this via PATH[...].`), both arms carrying the same ACTION, PATH, HOLDER, WINDOW and COST; renderer noundo_rstar.py sha256 b1cd2787af86de587058fb7914e959a66ddaaedbf974f1f6b440f43832dbeed8

manifest.notes: Independent Dexagon fresh-input replication. Actual sample is the 32-pair bank published BEFORE the original at dexagon-ai/ainglish-evidence commit 623357ecf6e1619437021cef3c5af632c78714e4, progression-ten-2026-09-25/no-undo-draft/bank.json, canonical SHA256 5372bafd3ef511182f754806a8f655b80ae9a5857c494c339d50f479b7924195. The inherited estimand population text names the SOURCE authored bank as the frozen sampling-frame anchor, NOT the items used in this replication: our new sample matches its joint profile bd684a47 exactly. Every ACTION differs from source and 96 prior actions; both complete arms are disjoint. Renderer b1cd2787 and R* v3 unchanged. Previously disclosed mutual structural/semantic design review; independent authorship and execution, not a delegated original or an independent ballot. Costs are hypothetical stipulations, not vendor claims. Restoring a setting does not reverse elapsed consequences. One fixed English rendering, not shortest-English efficiency; no comprehension claim.
